narrative.overview: A Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) editorial technology design system built for BJB Growth (Build · Join · Business). Rather than generic cool-blue/neon AI startup aesthetics, dark mode is derived directly from the official brandbook's organic palette: espresso brown grounds (Casca #2A211B), warm parchment breaks (Linho #EEE7D8 and Areia #DDD1B9), restrained amber interactions (Ocre #D9A566), botanical moss contrast panels (Musgo #4B4F3A), and terracotta numerical accents (Argila #9A4B30).
keyCharacteristics: Editorial Rhythm: Alternates dark architectural cross-grids (Casca) with high-legibility parchment breaks (Linho crosses and Areia dot matrices) so long-form operational content stays scannable without visual fatigue.
Restrained Smoked Glass: Glassmorphism appears only on navigation (bjb-glass-nav) and inspector/form containers (bjb-glass-panel), never repeated as uniform translucent grids.
Truth & Honesty: All components, copy, and visual tokens avoid fabricated client rosters, fake ROI metrics, and generic uncomped eyebrow stacks above section headings.

rules.name: WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast Floor
rules.body: Keep every text-over-dark / text-over-light pair at >= 4.5:1 contrast, using placeholder:text-[#DDD1B9]/70 on #211914 inputs and high-density smoked glass over light bands.

rules.name: Brand Asset Lock
rules.body: Enforce min-w-[96px] (25 mm) on all placements of brand-logo.png and never re-typeset brand lettering in Space Grotesk or any other font.

rules.name: Intentional Motion & Reduced-Motion Gate
rules.body: Gate GSAP typography/parallax motion behind (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) and preserve clear color/opacity state feedback under reduced motion.

dos: Keep every text-over-dark / text-over-light pair at >= 4.5:1 contrast (use placeholder:text-[#DDD1B9]/70 on #211914 inputs and single-layer opacity on inactive tabs).
Enforce min-w-[96px] (25 mm) on all placements of the complete logo (brand-logo.png).
Gate GSAP typography/parallax motion behind (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).
Label illustrative workflows and example metrics (EXEMPLO ILUSTRATIVO) unambiguously.
Implement accessible role=tablist keyboard controls (Arrow*, Home, End, tabIndex) and visible :focus-visible outlines (#D9A566 / #EEE7D8 / #9A4B30).
donts: Never invent cool-blue, purple, or neon gradients; stay strictly inside the Casca / Linho / Areia / Ocre / Musgo / Argila palette.
Never stretch, rotate, recolor off-palette, or re-typeset BUILD JOIN}*& BUSINESS' / B}b' in Space Grotesk or another font.
Never add decorative eyebrow labels or uncomped section index prefixes above <h2> section headings.
Never publish fabricated client names, logos, testimonials, proven ROI claims, or placeholder emails/phone numbers.
Never trigger tab selection on onMouseEnter or substitute raw Unicode arrows where <ArrowIcon /> provides crisp vector strokes.
